title: UMBRELLA: consolidate the Cubric family into Cubric Vision
description: Fabio, 2026-09-01: drop Cubric Prompt / Studio / Audio / @cubric/ui as separate apps; Vision becomes the all-in-one. Four phases - A recipes into Vision (gated on Cubric-Prompt MPI-35), B split the cubric-vision skill, C agent workspace, D skill build+heal loop. Plus Studio-retirement cleanup inside Vision.
